title: Make Contentment Your Ear-rings, Humility Your Begging
summary: Discipline is named plainly here before the mind has time to decorate it.
takeaway: Make contentment your ear-rings, humility your begging bowl, and meditation the ashes
lifeApplication: Make the next faithful repetition smaller and truer. Begin with the part of the day already in front of you.
